children: Field names are a promise the data does not always keep.
On one parcel layer, a field named for the full street holds the street number, on all 81,121 rows.
Every field is mapped in a crosswalk by what it contains, not what it is called. The original name stays recorded beside it, so anyone can see the mismatch.
